origin: Third Regional Development Project - three World Bank tenders for museum work at Stepantsminda and Mtskheta, both in the Republic of Georgia - is filed under country=United States, region_state=Georgia. It therefore sits inside every US-scoped client scope, and client-scope.audit cannot see it because the composer and the database agree about the wrong country. Two separate branches produce this: the US-state scan runs before the sovereign-country list, and the NUTS code-like branch reads the first two letters of any 3-6 character place as an ISO-2 code (Austin -> AU -> Australia, Fiji -> FI -> Finland, Malawi -> MA -> Morocco, Chad -> CH -> Switzerland). The second is the Bronx -> Brazil defect, whose fix covered only configured jurisdictions. CLOSED 2026-08-18. The branch was parts.every(codeLike), the legacy TED path, which fires on a single-word place name because one word trivially satisfies every. The old pattern accepted Austin, Fiji, Chad, Zambia, Malawi, Gambia, Queens and Bronx as codes and REJECTED the two-letter ISO2 codes it existed for. Fixed by making the shape of a real code explicit - ISO2, ISO3, or two letters plus a digit-bearing suffix, plus the literal ZZZ extra-regio marker - and by consulting the country-name table before the code table. Measured: 4 live projects and 26 live records change country; 3 records lose one, of which 2 are the Austin fix.

shape: one jurisdiction's document reader assumed to generalise to another's
input: Three real City Planning Commission reports (250108, 240092, 250046) passed to readFilingFacts from readers/clark-agenda-sheet.
assertion: the Clark conditions extractor is NOT applied to CPC reports, and readers/cpc-report reads only what a CPC report states unambiguously - applicant, decision, recorded vote exceptions - and no conditions. A conditions reader for legal resolutions is its own build.

guard.needle: IT DOES NOT READ CONDITIONS, AND THAT IS A DECISION RATHER THAN AN OMISSION

origin: New York carries ZERO conditions corpus-wide while one Clark County project carries 51, and the obvious move was to point the existing extractor at the New York equivalent. Measured before building: it returns 0, 5 and 0 conditions over three real CPC reports, and the 5 are an accident of one report containing a literal 'CONDITIONS:' line. It keys on CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL headings, bullet characters and a CLOSED LIST OF EIGHT CLARK COUNTY DEPARTMENT NAMES. Clark publishes an ADMINISTRATIVE CHECKLIST; New York publishes a LEGAL RESOLUTION - RESOLVED clauses and obligations in prose, 8 occurrences of 'shall' across 163 pages. Building a second reader keyed on RESOLVED would be a New York special case; a reader for legal resolutions is a different and more general thing, and would reach any jurisdiction that publishes decisions that way. COST IS NOT THE OBSTACLE and was measured too: a CPC report costs a median 497ms to fetch and parse against 1,883ms for a Clark staff report, and the 163-page one parses in 327ms - all 13 reachable reports would cost about 6.5 seconds.

input: CPC report 250108, which contains 'in favor of the application and 11 in opposition' (public testimony) and 230070, which contains 'in favor, none opposed and none abstaining' (the COMMUNITY BOARD's vote).
assertion: the vote fact is built only from the Commission's own exception markers - Commissioner, VOTING NO | ABSTAINING | RECUSED | ABSENT - which appear nowhere else in the document. 'In Favor' is never read as the Commission's vote.

guard.needle: AND THE ONE I REFUSED

origin: Every CPC report contains the phrase 'In Favor' and in none of the seven examined is it the Commission's vote: it is public testimony or the community board's recommendation. A pattern keyed on it would have printed a community board's 11-24-8 as the City Planning Commission's decision on a client document. ALSO FOUND while verifying: the Commission abbreviates itself, and 250224 reads 'duly adopted by the CPC' where six others spell it out - a pattern keyed on the full name returned nothing for it and the fact was silently absent rather than wrong, which is the missing-entry-deletes shape.

input: Seven CPC reports read for their IN THE MATTER OF applicant: five private, one public authority (The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey) and one city agency (the New York City Department of City Planning).
assertion: the applicant is written UNGATED, exactly as every other untyped applicant is. The reader does not decide whether a party is public, because the only available signal is the name and a name-shape rule is the label-read-as-the-thing-it-names defect. If a New York source ever publishes an applicant type the way ZAP publishes applicant_type, that is the fix.

origin: A CPC report says in plain English that the applicant is the Department of City Planning, and the system cannot use that without reading the name. applicant_type is published by ZAP alone; null means the source did not say, never that the applicant is private, and untyped applicants are ungated everywhere else - so gating here would be inconsistent AND would require the forbidden rule. Measured after wiring: the decision cost nothing, because ZERO projects gained an applicant. Every ZAP record carrying a ULURP number already had one, and the reader never overwrites a structurally-stated fact with a second reading of a different document, so neither public body was ever written.

input: The first version of readCpcReport, whose commission_action display was built as `adopted ${date} (Calendar No. ${n})` and whose the_vote display was `1 voting no, 1 abstaining`.
assertion: every FilingFact display is a verbatim substring of the document and of its own line, which is what verifyFilingFacts enforces. The counts are a reading and go in `value`; the display is the document's own words.

guard.needle: THE CAPTURED GROUP IS THE DISPLAY, AND IT MUST BE VERBATIM

origin: Caught by running the reader's output through the real verifyFilingFacts before wiring it, rather than by reading the code: all 13 facts would have been rejected. The guard exists so a client can check a value against the filing it is printed beside, and a reassembled string cannot be checked that way even when every component of it is true. After the fix, 7 of 7 reports passed the guard and 13 of 13 records were written with zero rejections.

shape: a captured value cut by a counter rather than by its own end
input:
The Anaheim agenda text 'Categorically Exempt from the provisions of the California 
Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to State 
CEQA Guidelines Section 15301, Class 1 (Existing Facilities) and Section 15315, Class 15 (Minor Land Divisions). 
Approved continuance...'
assertion: the stored ceqa_class display is the whole sentence up to '(Minor Land Divisions)' and never 'Categorically Exempt from the provisions of the California'. Every clipped value is a verbatim PREFIX of the matched text, so it stays a verbatim substring of the document.

origin: A client brief printed 'CEQA: Categorically Exempt from the provisions of the California.' Approved Resolution No' - a cut inside 'No.', worse than the truncation it replaced. input: An Anaheim council record whose captured text opens 'Adoption of resolutions dedicating municipal property for public streets, public utilities and other municipal purposes' in English and continues with the Spanish twin of the same item.

input: OCVibe's press block: $5 billion, $4B and $1 billion for amount reported; 100-acre against 20 acres for site; 5,000-seat against 300-capacity for seats.

origin: The stage got a reconciliation sentence this week and figures did not, so a reader met three project costs on one page with nothing to tell them the three are different claims. origin: The hook printed 'NOT RUN: the full Playwright suite. Nothing is on :3000. This push is going out WITHOUT the dashboard being exercised' and then exited 0. The banner was honest and the exit code was not, and every caller reads the exit code. Same shape as NEVER PIPE A GATE, one level up: the thing standing in for the work got checked instead of the work. The unconditional version is deliberately NOT the fix - the first version of this hook demanded a server for every push, so the only way to push a scraper change was --no-verify, and a gate bypassed every time also supplies the excuse. Verified on three real ranges: 076bcc4..41f6195 (dashboard) exits 1 and names 8 files, cbab57d..076bcc4 (agents only) exits 0 and reports green, and an all-zeros remote sha exits 1 because a branch the remote does not have yet cannot be diffed and must not silently produce an empty file list.

input: A referral brief built through the composer before its project picker has loaded, so geographyLabel resolves to the literal string 'one project'.

A document that cannot name its matter now throws instead of printing a placeholder.
